## Bug Report

```markdown
---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a bug or problem in the project
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug, needs-triage
assignees: ""

## Bug Description
Clearly describe the problem.

Example:
The login button does not work when users click it on mobile.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to ...
2. Click on ...
3. Enter ...
4. See the error ...

## Expected Behavior
What should happen?

Example:
The user should be redirected to the dashboard.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happens?

Example:
Nothing happens after clicking the login button.

## Screenshots
Add screenshots or screen recordings if possible.

- Device:
- Operating System:
- Browser:
- App Version:

Paste the error message here

## Additional Context
